# Data journal — Style Prompt

> A page from a financial paper, set in motion. Salmon paper, a short claret bar in the corner, serif headlines that rise from below their baseline like type being set, horizontal bars labelled right where they end, one huge serif figure that counts to its value, and a source line under every chart. The frame never moves; pages change when a second sheet with claret edges falls through the frame. Calm, exact, sourced.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **an article read page by page**. Each beat is one page on the same layout grid: a chapter opener (number, headline, rule, kicker), an article page (kicker, headline, a directly labelled bar chart) or a stat page (one figure, its unit, the sample it came from). The data carries the drama: only the subject of the story is in colour, everything it is compared with is grey, and the key word is cut out with a thin underline at the moment the reader needs it. Every page names its source, and illustrative numbers say so.

Not an infographic (no icons, no pictograms, no legends, no 3D, no gradient bars, no glow), not a dashboard (one chart per page, three to five rows), not kinetic typography (whole lines rise, letters never fly), not a slideshow of cards (no boxes, no shadows, no rounded panels: type and rules sit straight on the paper), and no camera (no zoom, no shake, no parallax).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Paper**: one flat salmon ground, no texture you would notice, no vignette. A second, slightly darker sheet exists only for the page turn.
- **Ink and rules**: type in near-black ink; hairlines at 1.5 px (the chapter rule at 60% ink, the source rule and table rules at 16% ink). No strokes heavier than the bars.
- **Bars**: solid 14 px bars with square ends, growing from x = 80 along the full 920 px column (the scale is 0–100, or the largest value × 1.25). The value sits at the right end of the row, above the bar, in the serif.
- **The claret bar**: 110 × 14 px at (80, 170), on every page, the only ornament.
- **Furniture on every page**: the source line (mono 25 px, a hairline above it, its baseline at y ≈ 1400) and a masthead below it (mono kicker, the publication's name in the serif with a small muted subtitle, four 34 px swatch dots: paper, ink, main, accent).
- **The page turn**: a full-frame sheet of the second paper with a 10 px claret edge at its top and bottom falls through the frame; the next page is already there when it leaves.
- **Masks**: every line of text sits in its own clipping box (padding 0.06 em top, 0.12 em bottom) and rises 108% from below it.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the salmon paper (#fff1e5); `--latar-2` is the page-turn sheet (#f2dfce), nothing else.
- `--utama` is the **data colour** (oxford blue #0f5499): the subject's bar, its value, the chapter number, the hero figure, the knife underline and the word it lands on. On paper all of these are drawn with `--utama-di-latar`; `--utama` itself fills only the button and its swatch, with `--teks-di-utama` on the button.
- `--aksen` is **claret** (#990f3d), used sparingly: the corner bar, the page-turn edges, a swatch. Never on data.
- `--teks` (ink #262a33): headlines, row labels, the values of the other rows, the chapter rule at 60%. `--teks-redup` (#66605c): mono kickers, the source line, the masthead kicker and subtitle.
- Derived: `--garis` (hairline) = `--teks` 16% over transparent; `--abu` (the bars that are not the subject) = `--teks-redup` 52% into `--latar`, so the comparison grey follows any brand, light or dark.
- Fixed in every brand: the rule that only one thing is in colour. The others are always `--abu`, never a second hue. No gradients, glows or shadows anywhere.
- On a pale main colour (pale yellow on white) `--utama-di-latar` falls back to ink: the subject's bar turns ink against grey, which still separates. Never force the pale colour onto text.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` (Libre Baskerville 400 when the brand has none): the chapter number 180 px (letter-spacing −0.04 em), the chapter headline 118–124 px, article headlines 96 px (Latin needs about 10% more than the CJK original to carry the same weight), the unit line 72 px, row and contact values 48 px, the masthead name 54 px, and the hero figure 290–300 px (letter-spacing −0.05 em, tabular figures, the `%` at 0.4 em raised to the top of the figure). Alternatives: Cormorant Garamond 700 (finer, more literary), Playfair Display 700 (louder, for lifestyle reports).
- `--font-isi` (Inter): row labels and contact labels 48–50 px at 600, notes 42–44 px at 400, the button 42 px at 600. Noto Sans or Space Grotesk 500 also suit.
- Mono (a fixed extra token, `--font-mono`, IBM Plex Mono 600): kickers 26 px uppercase with 0.1 em tracking, the source line 25 px as written, the masthead kicker 22 px with 0.2 em tracking.
- Numbers in Indonesian format: decimal comma ("94,2"), prices as Rp18.500. One headline per page on one line: a wider brand font means fewer words, not a size below 76 px.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Rise (text in)**: each line rises from yPercent 108 to 0 in its mask, 0.45–0.55 s `power3.out`; lines of one block 0.1–0.25 s apart; never per letter. Chapter opener: number at 0, headline +0.2 s, rule +0.5 s (scaleX from the left, 0.4 s `power3.inOut`), kicker +0.6 s.
- **Text out**: none on screen. A page leaves only under the page turn.
- **Page turn (edge wipe)**: the sheet falls from yPercent −102 to 0 in 0.25 s `power2.in`, the pages swap on the covered frame, the sheet continues to 102 in 0.3 s `power3.out`. The next page's headline rises 0.15–0.25 s after the cover.
- **Knife underline**: a line 0.08 em thick under the key word draws from the left in 0.32 s `power3.inOut`; on its last frame the word turns `--utama-di-latar`. It comes about 1 s after its headline, or 0.3 s after the note it marks.
- **Bar chart**: rows 0.6 s apart; per row the label rises (0.45 s), the bar grows from 0 (scaleX, 0.9 s `power3.out`, from +0.1 s) while the value fades in (0.2 s) and counts to its exact value over the same 0.9 s.
- **Hero figure**: fades in over 0.2 s while it counts for 1.1 s `power3.out` (one text update per frame, decimals kept); the unit line rises at the end of the count, the note 0.25 s later, the underline on the sample size 0.3 s after that.
- **Holds**: chapter opener about 1.6 s after its kicker lands, a finished chart 2–2.7 s, a stat page 1.5–2.5 s; the ending holds at least 2 s with nothing moving. Pages last 2.2–6 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera is locked: the frame is a page and never moves. These are the moves the page makes instead.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame | calm authority: the numbers speak | every beat |
| Page turn (claret-edged sheet falls through, 0.55 s) | a new section of the same report | between beats, every 2–6 s |
| Rise from the baseline | a statement being set in type | headlines, kickers, row labels, contact rows |
| Rule drawn from the left | a section opened or a row closed | chapter openers, table and contact rows |
| Knife underline | "this word, this number" | the key figure, the sample size, a deadline |
| Bars from zero with counting ends | a measured comparison | rankings, prices, before and after, results |
| Count to the figure | arriving at the answer | the one number the video is about |
| Hold | time to read | after every page settles |

## 7. Native moves

- **Chapter opener.** A big serif number in the data colour, the headline under it, a hairline drawn from the left, a mono kicker, then stillness. *Fits content like:* "01 · Uji tahan angin" for a creator's gear-testing channel; "02 · Harga cabai pekan ini" for a market news account; "Bab 3 · Pecahan" for a maths class; "Hari ke-12" in a travel diary.
- **Directly labelled bars.** Rows 0.6 s apart, the subject's bar in colour and first, the rest grey, each value counting at its bar's end; no legend, no axis. *Fits content like:* three umbrella frames in a wind test; delivery times of three couriers a shop tried; views per format on a creator's channel; class scores before and after a course; three suspects' alibis in minutes.
- **Counted hero figure.** One serif figure at 300 px fades in counting, a small raised `%`, then a unit line and a note naming the sample. *Fits content like:* "94,2% kembali mekar sendiri"; "Rp18.500 lebih hemat per pesanan" for a catering kitchen; "3,2 jt kali ditonton" for a creator; "87% peserta lulus" for a course.
- **Knife underline.** A thin line in the data colour cuts under one word, which takes the colour as the line ends. *Fits content like:* "Lolos 50 terpaan"; "dibalik angin 120 kali"; the closing date in a shop's notice; the twist word in a short story.
- **Page turn.** The darker sheet with claret edges falls through and the next page is waiting. *Fits content like:* question to answer; the problem page to the numbers page; one chapter of a report to the next; the last page to the call to action.
- **Source and masthead.** Every page carries "Sumber: …" over a hairline and the publication's name below. *Fits content like:* "Sumber: uji internal, 60 sampel · data contoh"; a channel's name as the masthead; a school's class name; a shop's monthly report.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **One colour for the subject.** Two coloured bars or a coloured competitor breaks the look; the others are `--abu`. Claret is never data.
- **Honest numbers.** Bars start at zero on a stated scale and end at the exact value; the counter's last frame shows the exact figure. Every data page has a source line; illustrative figures say "data contoh". Never invent a business's numbers: ask.
- **No decoration.** No icons, legends, gridlines, 3D, gradients, glows, shadows, rounded cards or background textures. Hairlines and the corner bar are the only ornaments.
- **Type discipline.** Lines rise whole inside their masks, never letter by letter, never sliding sideways or fading in place. Keep each headline to one line; give masks their padding so descenders and the underline are not cut.
- **Stillness.** No zoom, drift or shake. If a page feels static, it needs a better number, not a camera move.
- **Layout.** 80 px margins; reading text between y 300 and 1400; the masthead below the source line is furniture; the call to action stays above y 1500.
- **Initial states.** Set the page-turn sheet off-frame and the later pages hidden before the timeline starts (`gsap.set`), not with a timeline `set` at 0, or frame 0 shows the sheet.
- **Performance.** The page turn is one element moved by transform; bars grow with `scaleX`, rules with `scaleX`; counters change one text node per frame. Never animate width or top.

## Variation space

- Chapter openers may sit at the top (y 430, as here; article heads at y 300, chart rows from y 660, the stat at y 345) or mid-left (y 640); a list page may hold two to five rows (pitch 125 px).
- The hero figure may carry a full-scale track under it: a 26 px bar in `--garis` with a `--utama-di-latar` fill growing to value / scale over the same count.
- Rows may be ranked (largest first, the subject on top) or in the story's order with the subject highlighted wherever it falls.

## Measured from the references

Page turn: in 0.25 s (edge positions 3, 8, 17, 29, 47, 71, 100% per frame), out 0.3 s. Chapter opener: number 0 s, headline 0.2 s, rule 0.53–0.8 s, kicker 0.6 s. Headline 0.25 s after the cover, underline 1.05 s after it, first bar 1.3 s after it, rows 0.6 s apart. Hero figure: count 1.1 s, unit at count end, note +0.3 s, underline +0.9 s. Pages: chapter 2.7 s, chart 6 s, stat 4.5 s.

# Data journal: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3.2, long 5.4.

## hook

- en: chapter opener: a big serif number and headline rise from below their baseline, a hairline rule draws, a mono kicker
- id: pembuka bab: nomor serif besar dan judul naik dari balik garis dasar, garis rambut tergaris, label mono kecil

## problem

- en: one serif sentence states the trouble; a knife underline cuts under the key word, which turns the main colour
- id: satu kalimat serif menyebut masalahnya; garis pisau menyayat di bawah kata kunci, katanya berubah warna utama

## fact

- en: a mono kicker and one serif sentence rise like set type over a source line; nothing decorates the fact
- id: label mono dan satu kalimat serif naik seperti huruf disusun, di atas baris sumber; fakta tanpa hiasan

## step

- en: steps as table rows 0.6 s apart: mono number, body text rising, a hairline drawn under each
- id: langkah sebagai baris tabel berjarak 0,6 dtk: nomor mono, teks naik, garis rambut tergaris di bawahnya

## compare

- en: horizontal bars labelled directly, 0.6 s apart: the hero bar in the main colour, the rest grey, values count at the ends
- id: batang mendatar berlabel langsung, berjarak 0,6 dtk: batang utama berwarna, sisanya abu, angka menghitung di ujung

## number

- en: one huge serif figure in the main colour fades in counting, % small and raised; a unit line, then the sample note
- id: satu angka serif raksasa warna utama muncul sambil menghitung, % kecil di atas; satuan, lalu catatan sampel

## proof

- en: a small table: label left, serif value right, hairlines between rows, the source line naming who measured
- id: tabel kecil: label di kiri, nilai serif di kanan, garis rambut antarbaris, baris sumber menyebut siapa yang mengukur

## offer

- en: the price as the hero figure counting to its value, the old price in grey above it, terms in the note line
- id: harga jadi angka utama yang menghitung ke nilainya, harga lama abu di atasnya, syarat di baris catatan

## cta

- en: kicker, serif headline, contact rows over hairlines, one square-cornered button in the main colour; held 2 s
- id: label, judul serif, baris kontak bergaris rambut, satu tombol bersudut tegas warna utama; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the conclusion page: the verdict in serif, the deciding figure under a knife underline, the source; held 2 s
- id: halaman kesimpulan: putusan dalam serif, angka penentu digaris pisau, baris sumber; diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Jurnal data</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Libre Baskerville"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Biru grafik menjadi --utama, merah anggur menjadi --aksen.
         Sesudahnya milik tampilan ini, dicampur dari token supaya ikut brand: huruf mono, garis rambut, batang pembanding abu. */
      :root {
        --latar: #fff1e5; --latar-2: #f2dfce; --utama: #0f5499; --aksen: #990f3d;
        --teks: #262a33; --teks-redup: #66605c; --teks-di-utama: #fff1e5;
        --teks-di-aksen: #fff1e5; --utama-di-latar: #0f5499; --aksen-di-latar: #990f3d;
        --font-judul: "Libre Baskerville", Georgia, serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        --garis: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 16%, transparent);
        --abu: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks-redup) 52%, var(--latar));
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      ul { list-style: none; }
      em { font-style: normal; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      /* Masker baris: teks naik dari balik garis dasarnya seperti huruf timah yang disusun (clip-rise). */
      .m { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.06em 0 0.12em; margin: -0.06em 0 -0.12em; }
      .m > .i { display: block; }
      .label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .ttl { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.08; }
      /* Garis pisau: garis tipis warna utama menyayat di bawah kata kunci, lalu katanya ikut berwarna. */
      .pisau { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
      .pisau[data-acc="1"] { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .uline { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -0.04em; height: 0.08em; background: var(--utama-di-latar); transform-origin: 0 50%; }

      /* Perabot halaman yang selalu ada: pita merah anggur, baris sumber, tera terbitan. */
      .pita { position: absolute; left: 80px; top: 170px; width: 110px; height: 14px; background: var(--aksen); }
      .sumber { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 520px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--garis);
        font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 600; font-size: 25px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .tag { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      .tag .k { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .tag .n { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 54px; line-height: 1.1; }
      .tag .n small { font-size: 32px; color: var(--teks-redup); margin-left: 14px; }
      .tag .sw { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
      .tag .sw i { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--garis); }
      .tag .sw i:nth-child(1) { background: var(--latar); }
      .tag .sw i:nth-child(2) { background: var(--teks); }
      .tag .sw i:nth-child(3) { background: var(--utama); }
      .tag .sw i:nth-child(4) { background: var(--aksen); }

      /* Pembuka bab: nomor besar, judul, garis rambut, label mono. */
      .bab { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 430px; }
      .bab .num { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 180px; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .bab .ttl { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 118px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
      .bab .rule { display: block; margin-top: 26px; height: 1.5px; background: var(--teks); opacity: 0.6; transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      .bab .label { margin-top: 26px; }

      /* Halaman artikel: label + judul di atas, baris grafik di bawahnya. */
      .head { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 300px; }
      .head .ttl { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 96px; }
      .list { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 660px; }
      .list li { position: relative; padding: 22px 0 52px; }
      .list .txt { display: block; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }
      .lbar { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 14px; background: var(--abu); transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      .lval { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 34px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-style: normal; font-size: 48px;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
      .list li:first-child .lbar { background: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .list li:first-child .lval { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }

      /* Angka utama: angka serif raksasa, % kecil menempel di atas, satuan, catatan sampel. */
      .stat { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 345px; }
      .stat .val { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 290px; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.05em; white-space: nowrap;
        color: var(--utama-di-latar); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
      .stat .val sup { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0; margin-left: 0.05em; vertical-align: top;
        line-height: 1; padding-top: 0.15em; }
      .stat .unit { margin-top: 56px; font-size: 72px; }
      .stat .note { margin-top: 64px; font-size: 42px; line-height: 1.4; }

      /* Penutup: baris kontak bergaris rambut seperti tabel, satu tombol bersudut tegas. */
      .kontak li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 24px; padding: 26px 0 30px; }
      .kontak .k { display: block; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; }
      .kontak .v { display: block; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 48px; white-space: nowrap; }
      .kontak li:first-child .v { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .kontak .rule { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1.5px; background: var(--garis); transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      .tombol { position: absolute; left: 80px; top: 1000px; padding: 28px 46px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--utama);
        color: var(--teks-di-utama); font-size: 42px; font-weight: 600; }

      /* Lembar penyapu: kertas kedua bertepi merah anggur turun menutup halaman, adegan ditukar di baliknya. */
      .lembar { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 50; background: var(--latar-2); will-change: transform; }
      .lembar::before, .lembar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 10px; background: var(--aksen); }
      .lembar::before { top: 0; }
      .lembar::after { bottom: 0; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <i class="pita"></i>

      <section class="scene" id="pembuka" data-role="hook">
        <div class="bab">
          <div class="num rise">01</div>
          <h1 class="ttl rise">Uji tahan angin</h1>
          <i class="rule" id="rule"></i>
          <div class="label rise">Studi kasus · 3 jenis payung</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="grafik" data-role="compare">
        <div class="head">
          <div class="label rise">Hasil uji · persen payung utuh</div>
          <h2 class="ttl rise">Lolos <em class="pisau" data-acc="0">50</em> terpaan</h2>
        </div>
        <ul class="list" id="baris">
          <li data-v="88"><span class="txt rise">Rangka fiber</span></li>
          <li data-v="71"><span class="txt rise">Payung golf</span></li>
          <li data-v="46"><span class="txt rise">Lipat tiga</span></li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="angka" data-role="number">
        <div class="stat">
          <div class="val" id="val"><span id="nilai">0,0</span><sup>%</sup></div>
          <div class="unit ttl rise">kembali mekar sendiri</div>
          <div class="note rise">Rangka fiber · dibalik angin <em class="pisau" data-acc="0">120</em> kali</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="ajak" data-role="cta">
        <div class="head">
          <div class="label rise">Selengkapnya di kanal kami</div>
          <h2 class="ttl rise">Ikuti Lab Hujan</h2>
        </div>
        <ul class="list kontak">
          <li><span class="k rise">VideoSite & ShortVideo</span><span class="v rise">@labhujan</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
          <li><span class="k rise">Chat</span><span class="v rise">0812-3456-7890</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
        </ul>
        <div class="tombol" id="tombol">Tonton uji lengkapnya →</div>
      </section>

      <div class="sumber">Sumber: uji terowongan angin Lab Hujan · data contoh</div>
      <div class="tag">
        <div class="k">Edisi 14 / Musim hujan</div>
        <div class="n">Lab Hujan<small>Catatan uji alat hujan</small></div>
        <div class="sw"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
      </div>
      <div class="lembar" id="lembar"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const $ = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s), $$ = (s, r = document) => [...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const E = { masuk: "power3.out", sayat: "power3.inOut" };

      // Bungkus tiap .rise dalam masker supaya teksnya naik dari balik garis dasar.
      $$(".rise").forEach((el) => {
        const m = Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "m" });
        const i = Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "i" });
